_about: Which agent versions each adapter was written and checked against. Read by tools/agent_versions.py, the hook's capture mode and tests/test_agent_contract.py; procedure in docs/AGENTS.md. Evidence levels: live = allow and deny checked end to end on a phone (what was not checked, e.g. timeout, is said in the note); field-names = real input keys seen in hook.log or a capture, values made up; docs = taken from the documentation only; unit = made-up payloads only.

claude.title: Claude Code

updates.opt_out: env DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER=1 (settings.json env); DISABLE_UPDATES=1 blocks every path
updates.installs: native and npm update themselves; Homebrew/WinGet/apt do not

support.floor_basis: checked 2026-10-30 in the changelog: the plugin's hooks.json uses the exec form (`args` array), added in 2.1.139 ('Added hook args: string[] field (exec form)'); PermissionRequest itself exists since 2.0.45 (settings.json installs use the plain command string). Adapter checked on the baseline only

claude.no_opinion: empty stdout, exit 0: Claude shows its own dialog
watch: PostToolUseFailure (failed commands do not fire PostToolUse)
tool_use_id (PostToolUse has it, PermissionRequest does not)
a PermissionRequest hook keeps running after the dialog is answered
no hook fires on a manual deny or Esc

gemini.title: Gemini CLI

baseline.note: real captures on 0.64.0 (run_shell_command, replace, BeforeAgent, AfterAgent); allow x3 verified live on the phone 2026-10-21 (--yolo); deny verified live 2026-10-30 (file not created). Release notes 0.65-0.66: no hook changes. Not checked live: timeout; MCP tools untested for lack of a server

support.floor_basis: checked 2026-10-22 in the release notes: hooks existed before (0.24.0 has hook folder trust, 0.25.0 the hooks docs), but v0.27.0 'feat(hooks): enable hooks system by default' (PR 17247); older versions need hooksConfig.enabled and would silently not ask the phone. Adapter itself checked on 0.64.0 only

gemini.no_opinion: empty stdout, exit 0: Gemini's own approval mode decides (users run gemini --yolo so the phone is the only question)
watch: MCP tool naming mcp_<server>_<tool> (our matcher mcp_.*; read-only names skip the phone)

codex.title: OpenAI Codex CLI

baseline.note: 2026-10-30 on 0.166.0 interactive (-s workspace-write -a on-request) with the owner's phone: deny (file outside the workspace not created) and allow x2 verified live; real captures saved (Bash {command, description}, cwd = command dir since 0.166). While the hook waits Codex shows only 'Running hook' and no prompt of its own, so with phone mode on the answer comes from the phone. Not checked live: timeout.
